decision: not_made; this artifact inventories bytes and break-even projections only

method.container_framing: Read-only V1.0 parser; each chunk is u64 little-endian payload length followed by payload, so physical chunk framing is eight bytes per record.
method.graph_families: Exact current magic definitions from src/semantic_graph/graph_codec.rs, graph_codec_mutation.rs, graph_rewrite_baseline.rs and Graph open routing; unknown version suffixes in known families fail closed.
method.semantic_reference_widths: Memory-only mutation endpoints are 32-byte IDs; typed semantic endpoints are a 1-byte kind tag plus 32-byte ID (33 bytes). Graph version ObjectRef is 16 bytes (offset+length), not a semantic endpoint.
method.dictionary_projection: Hypothetical owner-local unique endpoint dictionary and fixed-width ordinals. Reports widths 1/2/4/8 and automatic smallest width. Includes dictionary header and entry overhead; leaves existing node mapping frames unchanged. This is not a format decision.

chosen_width.model: Hypothetical owner-local endpoint dictionary; one framed record with an 8-byte Container length, 8-byte magic, 4-byte count, and one kind-tag + 32-byte ID per unique endpoint (including Memory). Each occurrence uses a fixed-width zero-based ordinal. Existing node mapping frames remain unchanged; reuse is not assumed.
